title: Fire Emblem: Mystery of the Emblem - Intimidating Enemy ~ Theme of Encounter [Book 1] (Remix)
description:
Did a remix of Together We Ride / Theme of Encounter (Book 1) from Fire Emblem: Mystery of the Emblem. Never really got into the Fire Emblem series (yet), but it does have a couple songs that I really like (thanks to Smash Bros Melee & Brawl), and Together We Ride is one of them.

Important:
- "Bonus End," & Thunder SFX are disabled.
